name: Term Finance tETH price-feed decimals mismatch
summary: Term Finance's TermPriceConsumerV3 scales each feed answer by the feed's own decimals(). During a feed migration Term pointed the tETH primary feed at a new TermTEthPriceFeed whose decimals() is hard-coded to 18 while its answer, tETH.convertToAssets(1e18) times the 8-decimal TermWstEthPriceFeed answer divided by 1e18, has 8 decimals. usdValueOfTokens(tETH, 1e18) fell from $2,147.85 to $0.000000215, putting a healthy tETH-collateralised borrower into shortfall; two public liquidators seized 763.245 tETH in the next two blocks against about 8.5e-8 WETH of repayment.

loss.notes: Exact tETH moved from Term repo lockers to third-party liquidators in the only two liquidations executed while the bad feed was live: 173.087913214804282846 tETH from locker 0x5a665719a1bd1988ff906494777355d2a1080e87 to 0xfb9ae69c81610616bb7d3e8772b5933c7a16d75d (anchor, log 455) and 576.023352242445300288 tETH from locker 0xeac81e82ff8302a66a53779aa29412b88b95372a to 0x00000f91109c4d0007e90000d9facad5298a0cac (0xaa10cc07..., block 22353827, log 24). The borrower 0xe0478344ed218fe29f018caa9da1378c12fef331 lost 763.245440277197688475 tETH in total; the 14.134174819948105341 tETH protocol seizure share went to Term's protocol-reserve Safe 0xad30d904de4302ea13ef09242b49fcbf3822cb88 and is not counted as stolen. Liquidator repayments of 8.4927612073e-8 WETH are attacker-supplied and negligible and are not netted. Valued at DefiLlama's tETH quote $2,140.66 (timestamp 1745677615); cross-checks: the pre-change Term oracle valued tETH at $2,147.8513 and the liquidators sold 745.37 tETH for 877.05 WETH in the same transactions. Term's reported recoveries (about 556 ETH, 362 ETH / ~$650k net protocol loss) do not reduce gross loss. Two later dust liquidations of the same borrower at block 22362660 (4.3e-9 and 6.7e-10 tETH, after the feed was replaced at block 22362657) are immaterial and excluded.

ageReset.description: Term's DEVOPS Safe (via module 0x0c19d8a404079d71e5ca3e32fe3f758ab543acdf) called addNewTokenPriceFeed(tETH, 0xcc670a67566cd86e68b4c08e3692e1c35afa3c1f, 86400), replacing primary feed 0x4b24cce36bce862b16db35d4ade14ca7c200121d (decimals 8) with TermTEthPriceFeed (declares 18, answers in 8). usdValueOfTokens(tETH, 1e18) changed from 2,147.85133084e18 at block 22353824 to 2.15424411105e-7 e18 at block 22353825.
TermTEthPriceFeed with decimals() hard-coded to 18 over an 8-decimal answer; deployed about 34 hours before the consumer was pointed at it.

limitations: Not the knot: the defective feed was inert until the later configuration change in target-1 selected it as the tETH primary feed, which is the latest age reset of the exploited combination.

sources.note: Verified deployed sources: TermPriceConsumerV3 implementation https://etherscan.io/address/0xc3e49355fcf95af200250843d3872203589e6204#code (usdValueOfTokens scales the answer by 10**priceFeeds[token].priceFeed.decimals(); primary feed used when price > 0 and block.timestamp - updatedAt <= refreshRateThreshold), TermTEthPriceFeed https://etherscan.io/address/0xcc670a67566cd86e68b4c08e3692e1c35afa3c1f#code (decimals() returns 18; latestRoundData returns tEth.convertToAssets(1e18) * wstETHFeed.latestRoundData().answer / 1e18 with wstETHFeed = 0xa64a0a25de00c7ced3ccaa1f7ec51c3c8e3e899d), TermWstEthPriceFeed https://etherscan.io/address/0xa64a0a25de00c7ced3ccaa1f7ec51c3c8e3e899d#code (decimals() = ETH/USD feed decimals = 8).

Mechanism: eth_call decimals() at block 22353825 returns 18 on 0xcc670a67566cd86e68b4c08e3692e1c35afa3c1f and 8 on its hard-coded wstETH feed 0xa64a0a25de00c7ced3ccaa1f7ec51c3c8e3e899d; latestRoundData answers are 215424411105 and 215043831232 (8-decimal USD), so the tETH feed understates value by 1e10. The previous primary 0x4b24cce36bce862b16db35d4ade14ca7c200121d answers decimals 8, 214785133084 at block 22353824. Configuration anchor: tx 0xc660efb1c95cfd76fc1dc36c7d4e2df6b43ebd7174510b0c91736a3357c3c68f (block 22353825:44, from 0xbffcadcd5549cc378693108bcd4435776a6fa795 to module 0x0c19d8a404079d71e5ca3e32fe3f758ab543acdf, inner calldata 0x929ac838 addNewTokenPriceFeed(tETH, 0xcc670a67..., 0x15180)) emitted SubscribePriceFeed topic 0x950d6b0f... at log 259 on proxy 0x04fcd15c3582f0fa81a46533795196a5257f79c8 and ExecutionFromModuleSuccess on Safe 0xb8a1df43c1c88b13937c0c5cebbad15830caec03 at log 260. Storage: priceFeeds mapping is slot 251; eth_getStorageAt(proxy, keccak256(tETH . 251) = 0x9489465114686e30293e261e3b2ca4c4ca55ad59ec331140b934eb0db0bbc05c) = 0x4b24cce3... at block 22353824, 0xcc670a67... at 22353825 and 22353826, 0x4358e2d3c9658b50b0c3c353c9cbc6898de5bd72 at 22362657 (replacement tx 0xea8cd68f5fed8c33629646fd8f81723028d43ee96c25b03e3b7c8dd1b86ee0c6, block 22362657:29 log 110); refreshRate (key+1) = 86400; fallbackPriceFeeds slot 252 entry = 0x67ec80c1f91725736e13ae034ea15412e2adfbf9 throughout (unused while the primary is fresh). View call usdValueOfTokens(tETH, 1e18) (declared calldata) returns 2147851330840000000000 at block 22353824 and 215424411105 at blocks 22353825/22353826. Etherscan getLogs on the proxy for blocks 22000000-22400000 shows no other tETH SubscribePriceFeed between the reset and the anchor. Causality: for borrower 0xe0478344ed218fe29f018caa9da1378c12fef331, isBorrowerInShortfall is false at block 22353824 and true at 22353825 on both collateral managers 0xae72641e2f769ee4d35ae92474f1acba6262965a and 0x2477a725ff8ebe58b21b47bb865ce0a2681fbbe9; getCollateralMarketValue falls from 378781.578434611338908552e18 to 3.7990896902434e-5 e18 and from 1260556.156233134663810018e18 to 1.26430802598941e-4 e18. Anchor: debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of 0x8da015d7... (block 22353826:152) shows 0xfb9ae69c... flash-borrowing 19623177258 wei WETH from Aave 0x87870bca..., calling batchLiquidation-style selector 0x559e4fad on 0xae72641e (delegatecall impl 0x6a2e09f23ef3a1f5eced9d4daed3b27d181f93e1), which staticcalls 0x04fcd15c.usdValueOfTokens (delegatecall 0xc3e49355...) -> 0xcc670a67.latestRoundData and decimals; Liquidation event (topic 0x530fe3fc) on emitter 0x4c6aeb4e8dbbaf53c13af495c847d4ec68994bd4 log 456 records amountLiquidated 176.353722898102476861 tETH, protocol share 3.265809683298194. Earliest: all emitter logs for blocks 22353825-22362700 contain Liquidation events only in txs 0x8da015d7 (22353826:152), 0xaa10cc07 (22353827:8, sender 0x416bce75..., contract 0x00000f91..., 586.891717379095211614 tETH incl. 10.868365136649912 protocol share) and two dust liquidations at 22362660 after the fix; no liquidation between the reset (22353825:44) and the anchor. Target-1 history: proxy created top-level by 0x3210cf0892b794a9403f958fdb94ae2e13ac451f in tx 0x3d833e17... (block 20085609:32), no code at 20085608, runtime hash 0xcad5c8a15e8bbea0ad16a8036c8de5c5ae253e1062562c9fdde82ed93a2be332 at 20085609 and 22353825; the only Upgraded event (log 171 of that tx) sets 0xc3e49355...; EIP-1967 slot holds 0xc3e49355 at 20085609, 22353825, 22353826. Implementation created by the same deployer in 0x565966130631067929aca48fa96febbcd575d46f9f88746e457be7dc45565f91 (block 20085606:1), runtime hash 0xb2fb2b10b6299f19af0b2d0ad3716f947eb504a425878c0c63d949841731a358 at 20085606 and 22353825, absent at 20085605. Target-2: created top-level by 0xdace6985e42ec10f492d0919493964922b833b5b in 0xc63e3ca8... (block 22343567:18), absent at 22343566, runtime hash 0x630f4480dc1e2119cc98b190c7fc04744bcf8ac11a709ad7b24b81e8166b4c08 at 22343567 and 22353825; immutable runtime (no proxy). Loss: receipt Transfer logs of tETH 0xd11c452f... to liquidator contracts: anchor log 455 = 0x96213cc02820ccdde (173.087913214804282846), 0xaa10cc07 log 24 = 0x1f39ee0af644a93240 (576.023352242445300288), sum 749.111265457249583134 tETH x $2,140.66 (DefiLlama, ts 1745677615) = $1,603,592.52. Admission: the loss was realised by unprivileged third-party liquidation transactions exercising a persistent configuration state created by Term's DEVOPS role; this is not a direct privileged transfer. Term's post-mortem attributes the incident to a decimal mismatch introduced in the tETH oracle update and reports 918 ETH liquidated, consistent with 763.245 tETH at ~1.19 ETH/tETH.
